content:
Question: Can workspace W-77 retain deleted-user audit events for seven years?

Retrieved context:
[S1] Audit retention overview: Enterprise workspaces can configure retention from 30 days to 7 years.
[S2] Deletion guide: When a user is hard-deleted, profile fields are removed within 30 days; audit events may retain actor_id but not display name.
[S3] Workspace record: W-77 is on Business, not Enterprise.
[S4] Legal hold addendum: A legal hold can preserve audit events for 7 years when the workspace has the legal_hold feature enabled.
[S5] Workspace flags: W-77 legal_hold=false.

Answer for workspace W-77.
